description: [Riso] Location Lesson Window – NFR-05 – Riso Org Isolation – Other Partner Org Cannot Access LLW Object
preconditions: NFR-05 — Permission Matrix — The Location Lesson Window feature is Riso-specific. Users from other partner orgs (e.g., Aso, Koyu) cannot see or access the LLW object.
postconditions:
- A test user exists in a non-Riso partner org (e.g., Aso or a generic Manabie org)
- LLW records exist in the Riso org
steps_actions:
1. Log in as a user from the non-Riso partner org
2. Navigate to the Account detail page for any location
3. Observe whether a Lesson Window tab is visible
4. Attempt to access the LLW object via search or direct URL
5. Confirm no LLW records from the Riso org are exposed
steps_result:
1. Logged in successfully
2. Page loads
3. No Lesson Window tab is visible (feature is Riso-specific)
4. Object is not accessible
5. No data leakage between orgs

description: [Riso] Location Lesson Window – NFR-02 – LBAC – CM at Location A Cannot View Location B Records via List View
preconditions: NFR-02, BR-05 — Permission Matrix — A CM assigned only to Location A cannot see Location B's LLW records in the LLW List View, confirming Sharing_Setting__c record-level control is effective.
postconditions:
- CM Staff user is assigned to Location A only (not Location B)
- LLW records exist for both Location A (Status = Open) and Location B (Status = Complete)
steps_actions:
1. Log in as CM Staff (assigned to Location A only)
2. Navigate to the Location Lesson Window list view
3. Observe all records in the list view
4. Count total records visible
5. Attempt to navigate directly to a Location B LLW record URL
steps_result:
1. Logged in
2. List view opens
3. Only Location A LLW records are visible; Location B records are not shown
4. Only records for Location A appear
5. Access is denied or record not found

description: [Riso] Location Lesson Window – NFR-02 – LBAC – Sharing_Setting__c Config – HQ Sees All Records Across All Locations
preconditions: NFR-02, BR-05 — Permission Matrix — HQ Staff can view all LLW records across all locations, confirming the Sharing_Setting__c configuration does not restrict HQ access.
postconditions:
- Logged in as HQ Staff to the Riso Salesforce org
- LLW records exist for Location A, Location B, Location C (multiple locations)
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to the Location Lesson Window list view
2. Observe all records in the list
3. Open an LLW record for Location C
4. Confirm HQ can manage (edit, change status) any LLW record regardless of location
steps_result:
1. List view opens
2. LLW records for all locations (A, B, C) are visible
3. Record opens without access error
4. Management actions are available

description: [Riso] Location Lesson Window – Non-Functional – Edit Restriction – Complete LLW Fields Are Read-Only via API

postconditions:
- LLW record: Location A, July 2026, Status = Complete
- API access is available (developer console or REST API)
steps_actions:
1. Via the Salesforce API, attempt to update the Start Date of the Complete LLW to 2026-07-05
2. Observe the API response
3. Confirm the Start Date remains 2026-07-01 (unchanged)
steps_result:
1. API update request sent
2. Update is rejected by the Apex trigger/validation rule
3. Record is not modified

- At least 100 lessons exist for Location A in July 2026

2. Navigate to the SF Lesson List and filter by Location A
3. Observe page load time

steps_result:

2. Lesson list loads

4. All 100+ lessons are still visible
